description: Replace the earlier model-visible conversation with a concise Compaction Summary V2. Supply every fixed field, copy the latest request and active user constraints as exact bounded quotes with their zero-based durable message indices, cite compact evidence references, and keep current work and the next step explicit. Do not add an analysis field. The original audit history remains stored locally.

propertyDescriptions.formatVersion: The fixed Compaction Summary format version. Always use 2.
propertyDescriptions.primaryRequest: The active primary user request that the agent must continue satisfying. Preserve the Runtime inventory's pinned primary request even when a later steering message refines it.
propertyDescriptions.primaryRequest.sourceMessageIndex: The zero-based durable Thread message index containing the primary request.
propertyDescriptions.primaryRequest.text: An exact bounded quote of the active primary request from the cited durable message. Do not paraphrase it.
propertyDescriptions.activeConstraints: Every still-active user constraint. Use an empty array only when no active constraints exist.
propertyDescriptions.activeConstraints[].sourceMessageIndex: The zero-based durable Thread message index from which this constraint is quoted.
propertyDescriptions.activeConstraints[].text: An exact, bounded quote of the active constraint. Do not paraphrase it.
propertyDescriptions.technicalDecisions: Concise technical decisions that later work must preserve.
propertyDescriptions.technicalDecisions[].decision: One concise technical decision without chain-of-thought or extended analysis.
propertyDescriptions.technicalDecisions[].evidenceRefIds: IDs of evidenceRefs supporting this decision, or an empty array when none exists.
propertyDescriptions.filesAndChanges: Relevant files and their observed, completed, or planned change state.
propertyDescriptions.filesAndChanges[].status: How this file relates to the current work.
propertyDescriptions.filesAndChanges[].summary: Concise description of the relevant content or change.
propertyDescriptions.filesAndChanges[].evidenceRefIds: IDs of evidenceRefs supporting this file entry.
propertyDescriptions.verifiedResults: Results supported by concrete evidence such as tests, commands, or file inspection.
propertyDescriptions.verifiedResults[].result: One concise verified result; do not present an assumption as verified.
propertyDescriptions.verifiedResults[].evidenceRefIds: IDs of evidenceRefs that verify this result.
propertyDescriptions.errorsAndBlockers: Unresolved errors and blockers that future work must not lose.
propertyDescriptions.errorsAndBlockers[].kind: Whether the entry is an error or a blocker.
propertyDescriptions.errorsAndBlockers[].evidenceRefIds: IDs of evidenceRefs supporting this error or blocker.
propertyDescriptions.pendingWork: Concrete work that remains after compaction, in intended execution order.
propertyDescriptions.currentWork: The exact work currently in progress, or a short explicit statement that none is active.
propertyDescriptions.nextStep: The single next action the agent should take after compaction.
propertyDescriptions.evidenceRefs: Compact references to durable evidence. Do not copy large tool outputs here.
propertyDescriptions.evidenceRefs[].id: A short unique identifier referenced by other summary fields.
propertyDescriptions.evidenceRefs[].reference: A compact durable locator such as a message index, path and line, command/test label, task ID, or artifact ID.
propertyDescriptions.intentLedger: Structured user-intent lineage returned to Runtime for separate validation and persistence; it is not copied into workingSummary.
propertyDescriptions.intentLedger.userCorrections: Still-active user corrections or steering messages, quoted exactly and ordered by source message index.
propertyDescriptions.intentLedger.userCorrections[].sourceMes: The zero-based durable user-message index containing this correction.
propertyDescriptions.intentLedger.userCorrections[].text: An exact source quote of at most 400 characters.
propertyDescriptions.intentLedger.supersededRequests: Earlier requests explicitly replaced by later user instructions, ordered by source message index.
propertyDescriptions.intentLedger.supersededRequests[].source: The zero-based durable user-message index containing this superseded request.
propertyDescriptions.intentLedger.supersededRequests[].text: An exact source quote of at most 400 characters.
propertyDescriptions.coverageCheck: A short machine-checkable attestation used by Runtime before accepting the summary. It is not persisted in workingSummary.
propertyDescriptions.coverageCheck.coveredMessageIndices: Unique zero-based durable message indices represented by the summary, sorted in strictly ascending order.
propertyDescriptions.coverageCheck.latestMessageIndex: The zero-based index of the latest durable user message considered by this summary. It may identify a steering correction rather than primaryRequest.
propertyDescriptions.coverageCheck.latestRequestPreserved: True only when the latest active user request is represented.
propertyDescriptions.coverageCheck.activeConstraintsPreserved: True only when every active user constraint is quoted with its source index.
propertyDescriptions.coverageCheck.activePlanOrTaskPreserved: True only when any active Plan or DAG task state is represented, or no such state exists.
propertyDescriptions.coverageCheck.unresolvedErrorsPreserved: True only when unresolved errors and blockers are represented, or none exist.
propertyDescriptions.coverageCheck.currentWorkPreserved: True only when current in-progress work is represented.
propertyDescriptions.coverageCheck.nextStepPreserved: True only when a concrete next step is represented.
propertyDescriptions.coverageCheck.note: A brief coverage note for Runtime validation, at most 400 characters; never include analysis or secrets.

guidance: compact_context replaces the earlier model-visible conversation while preserving the original local audit history. Submit only the fixed Compaction Summary V2 fields and call the tool by itself. It must be cumulative and preserve the current objective, user constraints, key decisions, files and changes, verified results, unresolved failures, pending work, current work, and next step. Use RUNTIME_COMPACTION_SOURCE_INVENTORY as the authority for zero-based indices and exact bounded quotes. Keep the summary concise enough for the configured summary limit. Record decisions and verified results without chain-of-thought, cite compact evidence IDs instead of copying tool output, preserve unresolved failures and active Plan or task state, and state current work plus one exact next step. Include the inventory's active Plan ID, unfinished task-graph/current-task IDs, and latest unresolved command ID whenever present so Runtime can verify their continuity. primaryRequest carries the pinned active primary request; intentLedger carries every still-active correction and superseded request for separate Runtime validation and durable intent continuity. A later steering message remains a correction unless the inventory identifies it as the primary request. coverageCheck is a short Runtime-only attestation and its latestMessageIndex must still cover the newest durable user message. Neither intentLedger nor coverageCheck is retained in workingSummary or model-visible tool output. Runtime may reject a stale, incomplete, unverifiable, or low-benefit candidate without moving the compaction boundary. Never include credentials, image bytes, secrets, XML, or an open-ended analysis field.
